attempted_axis: Screen the remaining open movieplayer functions by RAW differing-word count (the ranking AGENTS.md makes decisive for candidacy), take the two cheapest, and re-measure their recorded EH-island caps at this run's alignment before spending a probe on either.

attributes.law_screen: claim.law.CV_pinned-residuals-are-unreachable-across-the-local-mwcc-archive SCREENED and CONSISTENT with the sibling's ~1370-compile archive sweep. claim.law.identical-multiset-is-blind-to-displacements.20260831.v1 APPLIED and DECISIVE for why these two functions look cheap and are not: both report `opcode multiset: IDENTICAL`, which reads as a pure reorder, while the deciding word is an IMMEDIATE that the multiset cannot see -- `fndiff --ops` surfaces it only in its separate IMMEDIATE-row section. claim.law.independent-statement-reorder-matches-target-schedule.20260830.v1 SCREENED and NOT SPENT: each function does carry a small independent transposition beside the island word (fn_800D96B0 a li/stw/lwz triple at [0x1a4,0x1b4), fn_800D9C5C one `mr` moved three slots), and closing it would leave the function non-exact anyway, so the lever was not worth a build this run -- recorded as not-attempted, not as measured-dead. No new law is asserted here; this record REPRODUCES two existing caps and types their denial.
attributes.probed_form: NO SOURCE EDIT AND NO PROBE SPENT -- this is a screen, and its whole point is that the screen was decisive before any build. The two recorded caps on this axis (attempt.EH_fn800d96b0-island-immediate-shares-the-9c5c-wall.20260901.v1 and attempt.EH_fn800d9c5c-island-immediate-is-source-unreachable-across-the-archive.20260901.v1, the latter reporting ~1370 compiles across local-declaration shapes, EH-region source forms and cflags) are both UNGATED-PROSE-DENIAL in `context`, i.e. weak vetoes by the corpus's own gate: no scope, no premise measurement, no expiry check, no falsifier. AGENTS.md says to re-measure such a premise rather than trust it. It was re-measured, and it REPRODUCES exactly -- see the typed denial and reproductions below.
attributes.residual: THE FINDING, and it is a QUEUE fact rather than a matching fact. The two cheapest open functions in this TU by raw differing words -- 4 of 113 and 5 of 38, the ranking AGENTS.md makes decisive for postprocessor candidacy -- are BOTH blocked on the same thing: a single same-opcode IMMEDIATE word carrying an identical +8 EH-island delta, on top of a recorded source-side cap that this run reproduced. Their cheapness is therefore misleading in BOTH directions: they are not cheap source work (the source axis is capped, ~1370 compiles on the sibling, reproduced below), and their word counts are not evidence of rule candidacy either, because the deciding word is a LITERAL and every shipped class is a register/schedule class -- probe.py's own decode annotation puts it as `a same-opcode literal difference is an eligibility-deciding word, not schedule noise; no postprocessor class reaches it`. THIS RECORD DOES NOT DECIDE THAT QUESTION (see verifiers_run: none were run); it reports that a word-count ranking of this TU puts two functions at the top whose blocking word is of a kind no shipped class is built for, and that the next genuinely open candidates are dtor_800DBB94 (11 words, 52 insns) and fn_800D8784 (12 words, 30 insns). Each of the two also carries a small independent transposition beside the island word -- fn_800D96B0 a li/stw/lwz triple at [0x1a4,0x1b4), fn_800D9C5C one `mr` moved three slots -- which are real, cheap and left open, but which cannot by themselves make either function exact.
attributes.scope: READ-ONLY measurement over game/movie/movieplayer. No source change, no config change, no probe. Two commands per function: wf_word_diff for the raw count, fndiff --ops for the decode.
attributes.verification: RAW WORD CENSUS of every open (non-100%-fuzzy) function in this TU, `python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py game/movie/movieplayer <fn>`, at commit 4e7d159e8: fn_800D96B0 113 insns DIFFERING WORDS = 4; fn_800D9C5C 38 insns DIFFERING WORDS = 5; dtor_800DBB94 52 insns = 11; fn_800D8784 30 insns = 12; fn_800D86C8 47 insns = 16; fn_800D860C 47 insns = 19; fn_800DACD8 204 insns = 38; fn_800D8BCC 215 insns = 66; PlayVQMovie 392 insns = 75; DTextInitColorRamp COUNT-ASYMMETRIC (target 51, ours 52, ours +1) so no word residual exists to measure. THE DECODE, `python tools/gdl/fndiff.py game/movie/movieplayer <fn> --ops`, verbatim: fn_800D96B0 `opcode multiset: IDENTICAL (113/113) -- but 1 IMMEDIATE word(s) differ at aligned same-opcode positions`, `IMMEDIATE T[95]@17c O[95]@17c   T: addi r3,r31,32   O: addi r3,r31,24`; fn_800D9C5C `opcode multiset: IDENTICAL (38/38) -- but 1 IMMEDIATE word(s) differ`, `IMMEDIATE T[18]@48 O[18]@48   T: addi r3,r31,28   O: addi r3,r31,20`. Both deltas are +8 bytes on an r31-relative EH address, which is the wall both caps describe, three runs and one full TU-flip campaign later.

denial.expiry_check: python tools/gdl/fndiff.py game/movie/movieplayer fn_800D96B0 --ops. If the IMMEDIATE row is gone, or if ours no longer reads `addi r3,r31,24` at index 95, the island has moved and this denial has expired. Run the same on fn_800D9C5C against `addi r3,r31,20` at index 18.
denial.falsifier: Any source form that emits `addi r3,r31,32` at index 95 of fn_800D96B0 (or `addi r3,r31,28` at index 18 of fn_800D9C5C) while holding the instruction count at 113/113 (38/38). One such form refutes the archive-wide unreachability claim outright.
denial.premise_measurement: python tools/gdl/fndiff.py game/movie/movieplayer fn_800D96B0 --ops at commit 4e7d159e8 prints `IMMEDIATE T[95]@17c O[95]@17c   T: addi r3,r31,32   O: addi r3,r31,24` under an `opcode multiset: IDENTICAL (113/113)` header; the same command on fn_800D9C5C prints `IMMEDIATE T[18]@48 O[18]@48   T: addi r3,r31,28   O: addi r3,r31,20` under `IDENTICAL (38/38)`. python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py gives DIFFERING WORDS = 4 and 5 respectively. The prior sweep behind the denial is the sibling's ~1370 compiles across local-declaration shapes, EH-region source forms and cflags, recorded in attempt.EH_fn800d9c5c-island-immediate-is-source-unreachable-across-the-archive.20260901.v1.
denial.scope: ONE axis on TWO functions: source-level pursuit of the 8-byte EH-island offset in game/movie/movieplayer::fn_800D96B0 and ::fn_800D9C5C, i.e. the single IMMEDIATE word in each. It does NOT deny the independent transpositions beside it in either function (explicitly left open and located above), does not deny work on any other movieplayer function, and asserts nothing about EH islands elsewhere in the project. It types, rather than extends, the two UNGATED-PROSE-DENIAL caps it reproduces.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: python tools/gdl/fndiff.py game/movie/movieplayer dtor_800DBB94 --ops and the same on fn_800D8784. If either prints an IMMEDIATE row, it belongs to the same dead class as the two functions above and drops off the queue for the same reason; if both print only reorder clusters under an IDENTICAL multiset, they are the real next candidates.
hypothesis.count_consequence: dtor_800DBB94 and fn_800D8784 are both count-symmetric today (52/52 and 30/30), so any candidate form must hold that; DTextInitColorRamp is the opposite case and its +1 instruction IS the work.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: no -- the word counts and the count-asymmetry above are measured, but neither dtor_800DBB94 nor fn_800D8784 has had its aligned view read this run, so the claim that they are unblocked rests on the absence of an IMMEDIATE row in the census, not on an inspection of their diffs.
hypothesis.statement: The remaining genuinely open work in this TU is dtor_800DBB94 (11 differing words over 52 instructions) and fn_800D8784 (12 over 30) -- both cheaper per instruction than anything else unblocked, and neither carrying an IMMEDIATE row in the census above. DTextInitColorRamp is a different job: it is COUNT-ASYMMETRIC at target 51 / ours 52, so its count must be closed before any word measurement means anything.
